note: Maps every string WP-43 puts on the site to the existing page and line, or the claim id, it restates (DP-5: no new criterion, timeline, count or response time). tests/unit/wp-43/sources.test.ts enumerates the strings from the page modules, fails on one that is not listed here, fails on a stale entry, checks each quote against its file and line, and runs the claims denylist over all of them. A "ui_label" entry is a control label or heading that states no fact about WE. The fit lists were moved verbatim from src/pages/program/who-its-for.astro at 2a9a7b0 (wp/40) and are pinned by tests/unit/wp-43/fixtures/fit-snapshot.json. The form field labels and hints were moved verbatim from src/components/forms/ApplyForm.astro at the same commit into src/components/apply/fields.ts. Three sentences of apply.mdx are unchanged and are not WP-43 text. Interface strings built by src/components/apply/stepper.ts (status line, review labels, error counts) are denylist-scanned and need no source.
